title: Onsite Calibration Days on the CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan Tiers
content:
Corbett's calibration technicians can calibrate instruments at the customer's site under the CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan. Each tier sets the onsite days included in a plan year, the fee for each additional onsite day and the smallest number of instruments needed to book an onsite day.

| Tier | Onsite days included per plan year | Fee per additional onsite day (USD) | Smallest number of instruments to book an onsite day |
|---|---|---|---|
| CalCare Pay-Per-Service | 0 | 2400.00 | 50 |
| CalCare Basic Plan | 0 | 2400.00 | 50 |
| CalCare Standard Plan | 0 | 2200.00 | 50 |
| CalCare Accredited Plan | 0 | 2000.00 | 40 |
| CalCare Onsite Plan | 4 | 1800.00 | 40 |
| CalCare Enterprise Plan | 12 | 1600.00 | 30 |

Definitions: the included days are the onsite calibration days included per plan year; the day fee is the fee per additional onsite calibration day, USD; the minimum is the smallest number of instruments to book an onsite day.

Only CalCare Onsite Plan (4 days) and CalCare Enterprise Plan (12 days) include onsite days; on the other four tiers 0 days are included, so on those tiers every onsite day is an additional day at the tier's day fee.

Hypothetical reading: on CalCare Accredited Plan an onsite day needs at least 40 instruments, and each day carries 2000.00.
